subject: Sixty-to-Ninety: ML/Infra handoff & readout — scheduling
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@tiltanalytics.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Lee <dlee@tiltanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: Next step — ML/infra deep dive

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for today’s discovery — that was super helpful. A few quick notes from our side attached (Tilt_Discovery_Notes.pdf). We’d like to move to a technical deep dive with our infra and ML engineering teams so they can validate performance and integration assumptions.

Goals for the 60–90 minute session:
- Confirm model sizing and latency expectations for our 2k QPS burst pattern
- Walk through network & VPC options and data residency controls
- Preview the Canary and rollback plan for a pilot

Attendees from our side will be myself (product), Devon (platform/infra), and possibly our ML lead (I’ll confirm). Can you propose 2–3 slots next week that work for Redwood’s ML/infra folks? We’re on US pacific time.

Also: we have a short security checklist request (SOC2 scope + audit logs) — happy to surface that in the session or handle offline.

Thanks,
Sasha Patel
Product Lead, Tilt Analytics
[attachment: Tilt_Discovery_Notes.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@tiltanalytics.com>, Devon Lee <dlee@tiltanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Next step — ML/infra deep dive

Hi Sasha — great to hear, glad the discovery was useful. 

Ben and Marissa from our ML/infra team are looped in (Ben will run the deep dive; Marissa will cover deployment/ops). We can run a 60–90 minute technical session and cover the checklist in-session.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2027-04-20 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-04-21 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2027-04-22 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, tell us two preferences and we’ll adapt. Draft agenda below — I’ll attach a slightly more detailed agenda after you confirm a slot.

Draft 90m agenda (flexible):
1) 10m — quick intro + available telemetry/SLAs
2) 30m — model sizing, latency targets, and expected traffic patterns
3) 25m — deployment topology (VPC, private vs hosted, key management)
4) 15m — rollout/canary plan and rollback strategies
5) 10m — outstanding security/compliance items & next steps

Action items: 
- Sasha: confirm preferred slot and final attendee list (ML lead if joining)
- Ben: I’ll prepare perf baseline expectations and questions about your QPS profile
- Marissa: will bring the deployment checklist and can attach the private deployment one-pager.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O’Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[calendar: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Hi Sasha — thanks for the notes. I did a quick pass on the discovery doc and have two clarifying questions before we lock the slot: 

1) Can you confirm the expected avg/peak sequence lengths and enrichment layers (e.g., external retrieval, embedding lookups)? That will influence model selection and memory footprint.
2) Are you planning to stream outputs to the client or batch some parts?

If you’re OK, I’d prefer Wed 2027-04-21 13:00–14:30 PT (gives us time to prep perf numbers). If the ML lead joins, please share their calendar so we can get them on the invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Staff ML Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Grace/Ben/Marissa — Wed 2027-04-21 13:00–14:30 PT works for us. Our ML lead, Priya Natarajan (priya@tiltanalytics.com), will join — copying her on the calendar invite shortly.

We’d like the session to focus on:
- concrete perf targets for our expected 95th-pct latency at 2k QPS
- integration points for KV cache and prefix caching
- what falls into Redwood Private vs Hosted choices for compliance

I’ve attached the discovery notes and highlighted the traffic profile on page 2. Also attaching a short SOC2 checklist we’d like to run through if time permits.

See you Wed — Sasha
